highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds a Vulkan Silk.NET package and syncs the Skia m151 engine.
highlights_body: This release introduces the new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, syncs upstream Skia chrome/m151 bug fixes, expands platform support with Nano Server font rendering via FreeType, and fixes a native memory leak in SKImage raster creation.

bullets.detail: Merged the Skia chrome/m151 bug-fix stream, keeping the bundled engine current with upstream fixes.
A new NuGet package provides Vulkan backend integration via the Silk.NET abstraction layer, enabling GPU-accelerated rendering on Android and Linux.

bullets.lead: Native memory leak in SKImage.Create fixed
bullets.detail: A CoTaskMem pixel-buffer allocated in the raster failure path was not freed; it is now released correctly.

bullets.lead: String allocation and uniform map performance
bullets.detail: Eliminated an intermediate string allocation in the GetEncodedText null-terminated path and pre-sized the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map to reduce overhead.

bullets.lead: Nano Server font support via FreeType
bullets.detail: Windows Nano Server containers now get font rendering through FreeType, resolving a long-standing gap for containerized Windows workloads.

bullets.lead: Containerized test platforms: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server
bullets.detail: CI now validates SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine musl-libc, and Nano Server containers, expanding the supported platform matrix.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Windows Nano Server containers, enabling rendering in minimal containerized environments.
